figure_label.rationale: Single unlettered whole-figure panel bundling two 12-lead ECG tracings and one frontal chest radiograph of the index patient (the case text cites Figure 1A for the left sided ECG and Figure 1C for the chest X-ray); pixels viewed at 4x with zoomed quadrant crops and 8x ECG crops. Both the ECG tracings and the radiograph are patient data an EHR would hold; the panel is recorded as waveform because two of the three images are ECG tracings.

label.override_reason: The deterministic default is other and not includable because the panel image_kind is mixed. The panel contains patient-attributed waveform data (two ECG tracings) and a chest radiograph, both EHR-includable patient-data categories, so the category is overridden to waveform and includable.
